name: bluebridge-sites
description: Plan marketing, save progress, and edit website drafts with hosted previews through Blue Bridge Sites. Human approval and publication stay separate.

defaultPrompt: Help me prioritize my marketing content
interface.longDescription: Read organization guidance, develop marketing plans and save working plans, decisions and content priorities with explicit consent. Edit website drafts through exact revision-checked changesets, check build results and open protected hosted previews. Resume saved work in another conversation. Actions require configured backend capabilities and current organization access. Image uploads, page deletion/renaming, analytics ingestion and social publishing are not available in this release. Human review, approval and publication remain separate.
